    <script data-own-cart="[]">
    (function () {
      if (window.top !== window) return; // the page itself, not a frame

      var SHARED = 'dptq_cart_us';
      var SYNCED = 'dptq_cart_synced'; // the cart both sides last agreed on (this host only)
      var LIFETIME = 60 * 60 * 24 * 14; // the mini-sites'
      var root = "\/en-us\/"; // this market's, e.g. /fr-fr/

      // This store's cart lines as this page was rendered, the way cart.js
      // lists them (in an attribute: a line property can't break the script).
      // Read here rather than fetched: the cart cookie is then switched before
      // any other script of the page sends a cart request. Apps update cart
      // attributes on load, and each answer sets `cart` back to the cart it was
      // sent for: one still on its way would undo the switch.
      var OWN = null;
      try {
        OWN = JSON.parse(document.currentScript.getAttribute('data-own-cart'));
        // Liquid gives the properties as [name, value] pairs, HTML-escaped:
        // back to cart.js's object of the values as they were added.
        var decoder = document.createElement('textarea');
        var unescape = function (text) {
          decoder.innerHTML = text;
          return decoder.value;
        };
        OWN.forEach(function (item) {
          var properties = {};
          item.properties.forEach(function (property) {
            properties[unescape(property[0])] = unescape(String(property[1]));
          });
          item.properties = properties;
        });
      } catch (e) {
        OWN = null;
      }

      function read(name) {
        var match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|;\\s*)' + name + '=([^;]+)'));
        try {
          return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
        } catch (e) {
          return null;
        }
      }

      function write(name, token, shared) {
        document.cookie =
          name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(token) + '; Path=/; Max-Age=' + LIFETIME + '; SameSite=Lax' +
          (shared ? '; Domain=.diptyqueparis.com; Secure' : '');
      }

      function publish(own) {
        write(SHARED, own, true);
        write(SYNCED, own);
      }

      function getCart() {
        return fetch(root + 'cart.js', { credentials: 'same-origin' }).then(function (response) {
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('cart.js ' + response.status);
          return response.json();
        });
      }

      function addItems(lines) {
        return fetch(root + 'cart/add.js', {
          method: 'POST',
          credentials: 'same-origin',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ items: lines }),
          keepalive: true, // still sent if the visitor leaves the page meanwhile
        }).then(function (response) {
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('cart/add.js ' + response.status);
        });
      }

      // The product (handle) a gift line was given for: the line it is nested
      // under, else the line of its `_parent_id` variant.
      function giftedProduct(item, items) {
        var properties = item.properties || {};
        if (!properties._gift_product) return null;
        var parentKey = item.parent_relationship && item.parent_relationship.parent_key;
        var parent = items.filter(function (line) {
          return parentKey ? line.key === parentKey : String(line.variant_id) === String(properties._parent_id);
        })[0];
        return parent ? parent.handle : 'variant-' + properties._parent_id;
      }

      // Re-add the store's old lines to the shared cart, each product with its
      // nested lines in one request: `parent_id` nests them under a parent
      // added in the same request.
      function carryOver(items, present) {
        var gifted = {};
        present.forEach(function (item) {
          var product = giftedProduct(item, present);
          if (product) gifted[product] = true;
        });

        var groups = [];
        var groupOf = {};
        items.forEach(function (item) {
          var product = giftedProduct(item, items);
          if (product) {
            if (gifted[product]) return; // one gift per product
            gifted[product] = true;
          }
          var line = { id: item.variant_id, quantity: item.quantity, properties: item.properties || {} };
          if (item.selling_plan_allocation) line.selling_plan = item.selling_plan_allocation.selling_plan.id;
          var parent = item.parent_relationship && groupOf[item.parent_relationship.parent_key];
          if (parent) {
            line.parent_id = parent[0].id;
            parent.push(line);
          } else {
            groupOf[item.key] = [line];
            groups.push(groupOf[item.key]);
          }
        });

        var lines = [].concat.apply([], groups);
        if (!lines.length) return;
        // An item no longer for sale fails the whole batch: retry product by
        // product, then a product whose nested line failed on its own.
        return addItems(lines).catch(function () {
          return groups.reduce(function (done, group) {
            return done.then(function () {
              return addItems(group).catch(function () {
                if (group.length > 1) return addItems(group.slice(0, 1)).catch(function () {});
              });
            });
          }, Promise.resolve());
        });
      }

      // A bundle the cart transform merged from its products (a virtual set)
      // is a single line, which can't be re-added as it is.
      function merged(item) {
        return item.has_components && !(item.properties && item.properties._components);
      }

      // Make the mini-site's cart this store's cart, carrying over the items
      // the store's own cart had, then reload to show it.
      function adopt(shared) {
        if (!OWN || OWN.some(merged)) return; // the store keeps its cart
        write('cart', shared);
        write(SYNCED, shared);
        if (!OWN.length) return reload();
        getCart()
          .then(
            function (cart) {
              return carryOver(OWN, cart.items);
            },
            function () {
              return carryOver(OWN, []);
            }
          )
          .then(reload, reload);
      }

      function reload() {
        location.reload();
      }

      function sync(onNewer) {
        var own = read('cart');
        var shared = read(SHARED);
        var synced = read(SYNCED);

        if (own === shared) {
          if (own) write(SHARED, own, true); // in step: keep it alive for the mini-sites
        } else if (shared && shared !== synced) {
          if (onNewer) onNewer(shared, own); // a mini-site started a newer cart
        } else if (own) {
          publish(own); // this store started a new cart
        }
        // Otherwise the store dropped the shared cart (checked out, expired):
        // nothing to share until it starts a new one.
      }

      // A page shown again from the back/forward cache, or from the HTTP cache
      // on Back, is a stale copy, and the cart page then reloads itself
      // (product-form.ts): a carry-over started here could be cut short. Such a
      // page reloads instead, and the fresh one adopts.
      var navigation = performance.getEntriesByType ? performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0] : null;
      var stale = navigation && navigation.type === 'back_forward' && !(navigation.transferSize > 0);
      sync(stale ? reload : adopt);
      addEventListener('pageshow', function (event) {
        if (event.persisted) sync(reload);
      });
      // Shopify creates the cart, and its cookie, on the first add to cart,
      // without a reload. It is published right away: a mini-site's first page
      // is requested before this page's `pagehide`, the fallback for a cart
      // that an app started.
      document.addEventListener('cart:add-success', function () {
        sync();
      });
      addEventListener('pagehide', function () {
        sync();
      });
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') sync();
      });
    })();
  </script>

// Debug mode for console logs (set to false in production)
const isDatalayerDebugMode = false;

// Conditional log functions
const dlLog = (...args) => isDatalayerDebugMode && console.log(...args);
const dlWarn = (...args) => isDatalayerDebugMode && console.warn(...args);
const dlError = (...args) => console.error(...args); // Always show errors

// Price divisor: 1 for zero-decimal currencies (XPF, JPY…), 100 for all others — auto-detected via Liquid
const PRICE_FACTOR = 100;

// Parses Shopify money strings safely across locales (handles space/comma thousands separators)
function parseShopifyMoney(str) {
  if (!str) return 0;
  str = String(str).trim().replace(/\s/g, '');
  return /,\d{2}$/.test(str)
    ? parseFloat(str.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.')) || 0
    : parseFloat(str.replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
}

    const mobRegex = /Mobile|iP(hone|od)|Android|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Kindle|Silk-Accelerated|(hpw|web)OS|Opera M(obi|ini)/;

    if (tabletRegex.test(ua)) return 'tablet';
    if (mobRegex.test(ua)) return 'mobile';
    return 'desktop';
  };

// VIEW ITEM LIST - Server-side generation (Liquid)

  // Client-side view_item_list for templates where product data is not available via Liquid
  (async function() {
    const selector = 'c-product-card, article.card-product, .product-card, product-card, [data-product-card]';
    const pageItemListId = "10330444923194";
    const pageItemListName = "eau-de-toilette-philosykos-philo100v2";

    let lastSentKey = null;
    let debounceTimer = null;

    async function collectAndPushItemList() {
      // Scoped to #MainContent so sitewide components rendered outside the
      // page content (search panel, add-to-cart popup, etc. — present in the
      // DOM on every page but hidden via opacity/visibility, not display:none)
      // never get mistaken for the page's own product list.
      const container = document.getElementById('MainContent') || document.body;
      const cards = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(selector));
      if (cards.length === 0) return false;

      const handles = [];
      const seen = new Set();

      cards.forEach(card => {
        // Skip cards hidden by CSS (e.g. an inactive gallery/tab panel) —
        // otherwise switching tabs re-collects the same full set of cards
        // (all tabs are rendered in the DOM at once) and the dedup key never changes.
        if (card.offsetParent === null) return;

        let handle = card.getAttribute('handle') ||
                     card.getAttribute('data-handle') ||
                     card.querySelector('[handle]')?.getAttribute('handle') ||
                     card.querySelector('[data-handle]')?.getAttribute('data-handle');

        if (!handle) {
          const link = card.querySelector('a[href*="/products/"]') ||
                       (card.tagName === 'A' && card.href?.includes('/products/') ? card : null);
          if (link) {
            const parts = link.href.split('/products/');
            if (parts.length > 1) handle = parts[1].split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
          }
        }

        if (handle && !seen.has(handle)) {
          seen.add(handle);
          handles.push(handle);
        }
      });

      if (handles.length === 0) return false;

      const results = await Promise.all(handles.map(h => fetchProductData(h)));
      const items = results
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((data, i) => ({ ...data.ecommerce.items[0], index: i }));

      if (items.length === 0) return false;

      const key = items.map(it => it.item_id || it.handle).join(',');
      if (key === lastSentKey) return false; // prevent duplicate list sends
      lastSentKey = key;

      cachedProductList = items;

      pushEcommerceEvent({
        event: "view_item_list",
        ecommerce: {
          item_list_id: pageItemListId,
          item_list_name: pageItemListName,
          items: items
        }
      });
      return true;
    }

    // Initial try — do not bail out permanently, allow future detections
    await collectAndPushItemList();

    // Watch for DOM changes and user interactions (tabs/carousels)
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      scheduleIdleDisconnect();
      clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => collectAndPushItemList(), 250);
    });

    observer.observe(document.getElementById('MainContent') || document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
      attributes: true
    });

    // Also listen for clicks on likely carousel/tab controls to trigger re-collection
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      const tabBtn = e.target.closest('[role="tab"], [data-gallery-tab], .gallery-list__tab, .tabs__button, .gallery-tab, [data-tab], .tabs button[data-id]');
      if (tabBtn) {
        scheduleIdleDisconnect();
        clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
        debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => collectAndPushItemList(), 150);
      }
    }, true);

    // Safety: disconnect after a period of inactivity rather than a fixed delay
    // from page load — a fixed timer (previously 15s) cuts off tracking mid-session
    // as soon as a user switches a product tab after that delay. Instead, every
    // mutation/tab click pushes the deadline back, so an actively browsing visitor
    // never loses tracking; only a genuinely idle page releases the observer.
    let idleDisconnectTimer = null;
    function scheduleIdleDisconnect() {
      clearTimeout(idleDisconnectTimer);
      idleDisconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => { observer.disconnect(); }, 300000); // 5 min of inactivity
    }
    scheduleIdleDisconnect();
  })();



 let lineItems = [];

 

 


   // ============================================================
   // NATIVE INTERCEPTION OF FETCH REQUESTS FOR THE CART
   // ============================================================
   // This approach intercepts ALL calls to the Shopify Cart API
   // Works with any theme (Ajax API, Section Rendering, etc.)

   // Cart events are tracked off the critical path: the wrapper used to await
   // them (a /cart.js read plus one /products/<handle>.js per item) before
   // handing the cart response back, delaying every cart update on the site.
   // A queue keeps them in request order, as the awaited add used to.
   let trackingQueue = Promise.resolve();
   let cartCache = null;
   let cartCacheTime = 0;

   async function getFullCart() {
     const now = Date.now();
     if (cartCache && (now - cartCacheTime) < 500) return cartCache;
     const response = await originalFetch(`${window.location.origin}/cart.js`);
     cartCache = await response.json();
     cartCacheTime = now;
     return cartCache;
   }

   const originalFetch = window.fetch;
   window.fetch = async function(...args) {
     const [url] = args;

     // Intercepts requests to the Shopify Cart API
     const urlString = url.toString();
     const isCartAdd = urlString.includes('/cart/add');
     const isCartChange = urlString.includes('/cart/change');
     const isCartUpdate = urlString.includes('/cart/update');
     const isCartClear = urlString.includes('/cart/clear');

     // Executes the original request
     const response = await originalFetch.apply(this, args);

     if (response.ok && (isCartAdd || isCartChange || isCartUpdate || isCartClear)) {
       // Clones the response to be able to read it without consuming it
       const clonedResponse = response.clone();
       trackingQueue = trackingQueue.then(async () => {
         try {
           // Handles cart additions
           if (isCartAdd) await handleCartAdd(await clonedResponse.json());

           // Handles quantity changes
           if (isCartChange || isCartUpdate) await handleCartChange(await clonedResponse.json());

           // Handles clearing the entire cart
           if (isCartClear) handleCartClear();
         } catch (error) {
           dlError('Error intercepting cart request:', error);
         }
       });
     }

     return response;
   };

   /**
    * Handles adding a product to the cart
    */
   async function handleCartAdd(cartData) {
     // cartData can be a single item or an array of items
     const items = Array.isArray(cartData.items) ? cartData.items : [cartData];

     // Retrieves complete cart information (including coupons) — cached 500ms
     const fullCart = await getFullCart();

     // Extracts discount codes applied at the cart level
     const cartLevelCoupons = fullCart.cart_level_discount_applications
       ? fullCart.cart_level_discount_applications
           .filter(d => d.type === 'discount_code')
           .map(d => d.title)
           .join(',')
       : '';

     for (const item of items) {
       // The API returns the handle in the response
       const productHandle = item.handle || item.product_handle;

       if (!productHandle) {
         dlWarn('No handle found in cart add response', item);
         continue;
       }

       const productData = await fetchProductData(productHandle, item.id);

       if (productData) {
         // Retrieves the actual discount from the full cart
         const cartItem = fullCart.items.find(ci => ci.product_id.toString() === productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_id);

         // item.quantity = total in cart after add — compute only the added quantity
         const existingCartItem = lineItems.find(li => li.variant_id === item.id.toString());
         const previousQty = existingCartItem ? existingCartItem.quantity : 0;
         const addedQty = item.quantity - previousQty;
         productData.ecommerce.items[0].quantity = addedQty > 0 ? addedQty : item.quantity;
         if (productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_variant === 'Default Title' &&
             typeof getProductContenance !== 'undefined' && getProductContenance) {
           productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_variant = getProductContenance;
         }
         productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_list_id = "10330444923194";
         productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_list_name = "eau-de-toilette-philosykos-philo100v2";

         // Adds the coupon if available
         productData.ecommerce.items[0].coupon = cartLevelCoupons;

         // Adds the actual discount if available
         if (cartItem && cartItem.total_discount > 0) {
           productData.ecommerce.items[0].discount = (cartItem.total_discount / cartItem.quantity) / PRICE_FACTOR;
         }

         // Update lineItems cache
         const existingIndex = lineItems.findIndex(li => li.variant_id === item.id.toString());
         if (existingIndex >= 0) {
           lineItems[existingIndex].quantity += item.quantity;
           lineItems[existingIndex].coupon = cartLevelCoupons;
           if (cartItem) lineItems[existingIndex].discount = (cartItem.total_discount / cartItem.quantity) / 100;
         } else {
           lineItems.push(productData.ecommerce.items[0]);
         }

         const atcEvent = addToCart(productData.ecommerce);
         if (atcEvent) pushEcommerceEvent(atcEvent);
       }
     }

     localStorage.setItem('dl:items', JSON.stringify(lineItems));
   }

   /**
    * Handles quantity changes in the cart (increase, decrease, removal)
    */
   async function handleCartChange(newCartData) {
     // Creates a copy of the current state for comparison
     const previousItems = new Map(lineItems.map(item => [(item.variant_id || item.item_id).toString(), {...item}]));

     // newCartData IS the full cart — no extra fetch needed
     const fullCart = newCartData;

     // Extracts discount codes applied at the cart level
     const cartLevelCoupons = fullCart.cart_level_discount_applications
       ? fullCart.cart_level_discount_applications
           .filter(d => d.type === 'discount_code')
           .map(d => d.title)
           .join(',')
       : '';

     // Processes each item in the new cart
     if (newCartData.items && Array.isArray(newCartData.items)) {
       const newItemsMap = new Map(newCartData.items.map(item => [item.variant_id.toString(), item]));

       // 1. Detects quantity changes (increase or decrease)
       for (const [variantId, newItem] of newItemsMap) {
         const previousItem = previousItems.get(variantId);

         if (previousItem) {
           const quantityDiff = newItem.quantity - previousItem.quantity;

           if (quantityDiff > 0) {
             // Quantity increase = addition
             const productData = await fetchProductData(newItem.handle, newItem.variant_id);
             if (productData) {
               // Retrieves the actual discount from the full cart
               const cartItem = fullCart.items.find(ci => ci.product_id.toString() === productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_id);

               productData.ecommerce.items[0].quantity = quantityDiff;
               if (productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_variant === 'Default Title' && previousItem?.item_variant && previousItem.item_variant !== 'Default Title') {
                 productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_variant = previousItem.item_variant;
               }
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_list_id = "10330444923194";
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_list_name = "eau-de-toilette-philosykos-philo100v2";
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].coupon = cartLevelCoupons;

               // Adds the actual discount if available
               if (cartItem && cartItem.total_discount > 0) {
                 productData.ecommerce.items[0].discount = (cartItem.total_discount / cartItem.quantity) / PRICE_FACTOR;
               }

               const atcEvent = addToCart(productData.ecommerce);
               if (atcEvent) pushEcommerceEvent(atcEvent);
             }
           } else if (quantityDiff < 0) {
             // Quantity decrease = partial removal
             const productData = await fetchProductData(newItem.handle, newItem.variant_id);
             if (productData) {
               // Retrieves the actual discount from the full cart
               const cartItem = fullCart.items.find(ci => ci.product_id.toString() === productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_id);

               productData.ecommerce.items[0].quantity = Math.abs(quantityDiff);
               if (productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_variant === 'Default Title' && previousItem?.item_variant && previousItem.item_variant !== 'Default Title') {
                 productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_variant = previousItem.item_variant;
               }
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_list_id = "10330444923194";
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_list_name = "eau-de-toilette-philosykos-philo100v2";
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].coupon = cartLevelCoupons;

               // Adds the actual discount if available
               if (cartItem && cartItem.total_discount > 0) {
                 productData.ecommerce.items[0].discount = (cartItem.total_discount / cartItem.quantity) / PRICE_FACTOR;
               }

               pushEcommerceEvent(removeFromCart(productData.ecommerce));
             }
           }

           // Updates the cache with the discount
           const cartItem = fullCart.items.find(ci => ci.variant_id.toString() === variantId);
           previousItem.quantity = newItem.quantity;
           previousItem.coupon = cartLevelCoupons;
           if (cartItem && cartItem.total_discount > 0) {
             previousItem.discount = (cartItem.total_discount / cartItem.quantity) / PRICE_FACTOR;
           }
         }
       }

       // 2. Detects complete removals (products no longer in the cart)
       for (const [variantId, previousItem] of previousItems) {
         if (!newItemsMap.has(variantId)) {
           // Product completely removed from the cart
           dlLog('Product deleted detected:', variantId, previousItem);

           // Uses the handle stored in the cache
           if (previousItem.handle) {
             const productData = await fetchProductData(previousItem.handle, previousItem.variant_id);
             if (productData) {
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].quantity = previousItem.quantity;
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_list_id = "10330444923194";
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].item_list_name = "eau-de-toilette-philosykos-philo100v2";
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].coupon = cartLevelCoupons;
               // Uses the discount from the cache (as the product is no longer in the cart)
               productData.ecommerce.items[0].discount = previousItem.discount || 0;
               pushEcommerceEvent(removeFromCart(productData.ecommerce));
             }
           } else {
             // Fallback: uses data directly from the cache
             dlWarn('No handle found, using cache data');
             pushEcommerceEvent(removeFromCart({
               items: [{
                 ...previousItem,
                 item_list_id: "10330444923194",
                 item_list_name: "eau-de-toilette-philosykos-philo100v2",
                 coupon: cartLevelCoupons
               }]
             }));
           }
         }
       }

       // 3. Updates the lineItems cache with the new state
       lineItems = newCartData.items.map(item => {
         const existingItem = previousItems.get(item.variant_id.toString());
         const cartItem = fullCart.items.find(ci => ci.variant_id === item.variant_id);
         const itemDiscount = cartItem && cartItem.total_discount > 0
           ? (cartItem.total_discount / cartItem.quantity) / PRICE_FACTOR
           : 0;

         return existingItem
           ? { ...existingItem, quantity: item.quantity, coupon: cartLevelCoupons, discount: itemDiscount }
           : {
               item_id: item.product_id.toString(),
               variant_id: item.variant_id.toString(),
               handle: item.handle,
               item_name: item.product_title,
               item_sku: item.sku || '',
               ean: '',
               quantity: item.quantity,
               price: item.price / PRICE_FACTOR,
               discount: itemDiscount,
               coupon: cartLevelCoupons
             };
       });

       localStorage.setItem('dl:items', JSON.stringify(lineItems));
     }
   }   /**
    * Handles clearing the entire cart
    */
   function handleCartClear() {
     // Sends a removal event for each item
     lineItems.forEach(item => {
       pushEcommerceEvent(removeFromCart({ items: [item] }));
     });

     // Clears the cache
     lineItems = [];
     localStorage.setItem('dl:items', JSON.stringify(lineItems));
   }


 localStorage.setItem('dl:items', JSON.stringify(lineItems));

   /**
    * Handles global clicks for UI Tracking and Select Item
    */
   document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {

     // 1. CLICK SEARCH (only on open, not on close)
     if (event.target.closest('[data-btn-toogle-search], .header__search-button')) {
       const searchDialog = document.querySelector('[data-search-dialog]');
       if (!searchDialog || !searchDialog.open) {
         dataLayer.push({ event: 'clickSearch', searchType: 'Products' });
       }
     }

     // 2. CLICK NAV — top-level items, mobile toggles, and all submenu links
     const navLink = event.target.closest('.menu__level-1, .menu__level-1-arrow, .menu__submenu a, .menu__level-1-label--mobile');
     if (navLink) {
       let mainLevel = '';
       if (navLink.classList.contains('menu__level-1-arrow')) {
         const child = navLink.querySelector('.menu__level-1');
         mainLevel = child ? child.innerText.trim() : '';
       } else {
         mainLevel = navLink.innerText.trim();
       }
       if (mainLevel) dataLayer.push({ event: 'clickNav', mainLevel });
     }

     // 3. CLICK CHANGE LANGUAGE — handled via change event below (not click)

     // 4. CLICK FOOTER NAV
     const footerLink = event.target.closest('.footer-menu__link');
     if (footerLink) {
       const categoryElement = footerLink.closest('t-accordeon').querySelector('.footer-menu__title');
       const category = categoryElement ? categoryElement.innerText.trim() : '';
       dataLayer.push({
         event: 'clickFooterNav',
         category: category,
         link: footerLink.getAttribute('href')
       });
     }

     // 5. CLICK FILTER (Sort & Refinement)
     const filterLabel = event.target.closest('label');
     const filterInput = event.target.closest('input[type="radio"], input[type="checkbox"]');
     const targetFilter = filterLabel || filterInput;

     if (targetFilter && (targetFilter.closest('.filter-content') || targetFilter.closest('[data-gtm-form-interact-id]'))) {
        let value = "";
        let type = "";

        if (filterLabel) {
            value = filterLabel.innerText.trim();
        } else if (filterInput) {
            const labelFor = document.querySelector(`label[for="${filterInput.id}"]`);
            value = labelFor ? labelFor.innerText.trim() : filterInput.value;
        }

        const fieldset = targetFilter.closest('fieldset');
        if (fieldset) {
            const legend = fieldset.querySelector('legend, .filter-legend, [data-legend-sortby]');
            type = legend ? legend.innerText.trim() : "";
        } else {
            const groupTitle = targetFilter.closest('.filter-group')?.querySelector('.filter-group__title');
            type = groupTitle ? groupTitle.innerText.trim() : "";
        }

        if (value) {
            dataLayer.push({
                event: 'clickFilter',
                filterType: type.replace(':', '').trim(),
                filterValue: value
            });
        }
     }

     // 6. CLICK HP PICTURES (Homepage Only — editorial sections only)
     

     // 7. CLICK FOOTER NEWSLETTER
     if (event.target.closest('c-form-newsletter [type="submit"], .newsletter_form [type="submit"]')) {
       dataLayer.push({ event: 'clickFooterNewsletter' });
     }

     // 8. CLICK SEE ALL THE PRODUCTS
     const seeAllButton = event.target.closest('a.button-primary, a.button-secondary');
     if (seeAllButton && seeAllButton.href && seeAllButton.href.includes('/collections/')) {
       dataLayer.push({
         event: 'clickSeeAllTheProducts'
       });
     }

     // 9. CLICK FOOTER SOCIAL
     const socialLink = event.target.closest('.social-menu-link');
     if (socialLink) {
       const socialName = socialLink.querySelector('.sr-only')?.innerText.trim() || "";
       dataLayer.push({
         event: 'clickFooterSocial',
         socialName: socialName
       });
     }

     // 10. CLICK SUBMIT REQUEST
     const submitRequestBtn = event.target.closest('#new_request input[type="submit"]');
     if (submitRequestBtn) {
       dataLayer.push({
         event: 'submitRequest'
       });
     }

     // 11. CLICK CLOSE POPIN
     if (event.target.closest('.popin-close, .header-search__close, [data-popup-atc-close], [data-samples-close], [data-engraving-close], [data-traceability-popup-close]')) {
       dataLayer.push({
         event: 'click_close_popin'
       });
     }

     // 12. SELECT ITEM (Product Card)
     // Exclude button clicks (add-to-cart, quick-add, etc.)
     if (event.target.closest('button, [role="button"], input[type="submit"]')) return;

     const card = event.target.closest('c-product-card, article.card-product, .product-card, product-card, [data-product-card], a[href*="/products/"]');

     if (!card) return;

     // If it's a direct link, go up to the card container
     let productCard = card;
     if (card.tagName === 'A') {
       productCard = card.closest('c-product-card, article.card-product, .product-card, product-card, [data-product-card]') || card;
     }

     // Avoid duplicates
     if (productCard.classList.contains('gtm-tracked')) return;
     productCard.classList.add('gtm-tracked');

     // Retrieves the product ID or handle
     let productId = productCard.getAttribute('data-product-id') ||
                     productCard.querySelector('[data-product-id]')?.getAttribute('data-product-id');

     let productHandle = productCard.getAttribute('handle') ||
                         productCard.getAttribute('data-handle') ||
                         productCard.querySelector('[handle]')?.getAttribute('handle') ||
                         productCard.querySelector('[data-handle]')?.getAttribute('data-handle');

     if (!productHandle) {
       const productLink = productCard.querySelector('a[href*="/products/"]') ||
                          (productCard.tagName === 'A' && productCard.href.includes('/products/') ? productCard : null);
       if (productLink) {
         const urlParts = productLink.href.split('/products/');
         if (urlParts.length > 1) {
           productHandle = urlParts[1].split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
         }
       }
     }

     if (!productId && !productHandle) return;

     // Searches for the product in the cache
     let productItem = null;

     if (productId) {
       productItem = cachedProductList.find(item => item.item_id == productId || item.item_id === productId.toString());
     }

     if (!productItem && productHandle) {
       productItem = cachedProductList.find(item => item.handle === productHandle);
     }

     if (productItem) {
       const selectItemObject = {
         event: "select_item",
         ecommerce: {
           
           item_list_id: "",
           item_list_name: "other",
           
           items: [productItem]
         }
       };
       pushEcommerceEvent(selectItemObject);
     } else if (productHandle) {
       // Fallback: fetch if not in cache
       fetchProductData(productHandle).then(productData => {
         if (productData) {
           const allCards = document.querySelectorAll('c-product-card, article.card-product, .product-card, product-card, [data-product-card]');
           const index = Array.from(allCards).indexOf(productCard);
           productData.ecommerce.items[0].index = index >= 0 ? index : 0;
           const selectItemObject = {
             event: "select_item",
             ecommerce: {
               
               item_list_id: "",
               item_list_name: "other",
               
               items: productData.ecommerce.items
             }
           };
           pushEcommerceEvent(selectItemObject);
         }
       });
     }
   }, true); // true = capture phase

   // CHANGE LANGUAGE — fires when country or language selector changes value
   document.addEventListener('change', function(event) {
     const selector = event.target.closest('.country-selector, .language-selector');
     if (selector) {
       const action = selector.classList.contains('language-selector') ? 'Language' : 'Country';
       const selected = selector.options[selector.selectedIndex];
       const country = selected ? selected.text.trim() : '';
       dataLayer.push({ event: 'clickChangeLanguage', action, country });
     }
   });

   // RESULT AUTOCOMPLETE — MutationObserver on predictive search results
   const searchInput = document.querySelector('.header-search__input');
   const predictiveResult = document.querySelector('[data-predictive-result]');

   if (predictiveResult) {
     let autocompleteDebounce = null;

     const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
       const isOpen = predictiveResult.querySelector('.header-search__product-result.is-open');
       if (!isOpen) return;

       clearTimeout(autocompleteDebounce);
       autocompleteDebounce = setTimeout(() => {
         const query = searchInput ? searchInput.value.trim() : '';
         const countEl = predictiveResult.querySelector('.result-title .label-m-alternate');
         const countMatch = countEl ? countEl.innerText.match(/\d+/) : null;
         const resultCount = countMatch ? parseInt(countMatch[0]) : 0;

         if (query.length > 0) {
           dataLayer.push({
             event: 'resultAutocomplete',
             page_url: window.location.pathname,
             page_type: 'AutoComplete',
             search_engine: 'shopify',
             search_page_number: 1,
             search_query: query,
             search_product_results: resultCount
           });
         }
       }, 300);
     });

     observer.observe(predictiveResult, { childList: true, subtree: true });
   }

   // CLICK CHAT
   if (window.zE) {
     zE('webWidget:on', 'open', function() {
       dataLayer.push({ event: 'clickChat' });
     });
   } else {
     window.addEventListener('blur', function() {
       setTimeout(function() {
         if (document.activeElement.id === 'launcher') {
           dataLayer.push({ event: 'clickChat' });
         }
       }, 100);
     });
   }

}); // End of DOMContentLoaded


// ============================================================
// REUSABLE FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================

/**
 * Retrieves product data via the native Shopify Ajax API
 */
async function fetchProductData(handle, variantId) {
    try {
        const handleParts = handle.split('/');
        const cleanHandle = handleParts[handleParts.length - 1]
            .split('?')[0]
            .replace('/products/', '');

        const response = await fetch(`${Shopify.routes.root}products/${cleanHandle}.js`);
        if (!response.ok) return null;
        const productData = await response.json();
        return formatProductDataForGTM(productData, variantId);
    } catch (error) {
        dlError("Error fetching product data:", error);
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Formats Shopify product data into GTM/GA4 format
 */
function formatProductDataForGTM(product, variantId) {
    let variant = product.variants && product.variants.length > 0
        ? product.variants[0]
        : null;

    if (variantId && product.variants) {
        const found = product.variants.find(v => v.id == variantId);
        if (found) variant = found;
    }

    if (!variant) return null;

    const categories = product.type ? product.type.split('/') : [];
    let itemDiscount = 0;
    if (variant.compare_at_price && variant.compare_at_price > variant.price) {
        itemDiscount = (variant.compare_at_price - variant.price) / PRICE_FACTOR;
    }

    const item = {
        item_name: product.title,
        item_id: product.id.toString(),
        item_sku: variant.sku || '',
        affiliation: "Online Store",
        coupon: "",
        discount: itemDiscount,
        index: 1,
        item_brand: "Diptyque Paris",
        item_category: categories[0] || '',
        item_category2: categories[1] || '',
        item_category3: categories[2] || '',
        item_variant: variant.title.replace(/\//g, '|'),
        price: variant.price / PRICE_FACTOR,
        quantity: 1,
        variant_id: variant.id.toString(),
        handle: product.handle
    };

    if (variant.barcode) {
        item.ean = variant.barcode;
    }

    return {
        ecommerce: {
            currency: Shopify.currency.active || 'USD',
            value: variant.price / PRICE_FACTOR,
            items: [item]
        }
    };
}

function pushEcommerceEvent(obj) {
  if (!obj?.ecommerce?.items) {
    dataLayer.push(obj);
    return;
  }
  dataLayer.push({
    ...obj,
    ecommerce: {
      ...obj.ecommerce,
      items: obj.ecommerce.items.map(({ variant_id, handle, ...item }) => item)
    }
  });
}

const addToCart = (productData) => {
    if (!productData.items ||
        productData.items.length < 1 ||
        !productData.items[0].price ||
        parseFloat(productData.items[0].price) == 0) {
        return null;
    }
    return { event: "add_to_cart", ecommerce: productData };
}

const removeFromCart = (productData) => {
     return { event: "remove_from_cart", ecommerce: productData }
}

    ;(function () {
      // Methods
      const checkBannerStorage = (banner) => {
        const storedBannerId = sessionStorage.getItem(`bannerContent-${banner.getAttribute('data-id')}`)
        foundBanner = banner
        if (storedBannerId !== banner.getAttribute('data-id') && banner.getAttribute('data-show') === 'true') {
          banner.parentElement.classList.remove('is-hide')
        } else {
          banner.parentElement.classList.add('is-hide')
          banner.parentElement.remove()
        }
      }

      // Check which banner should be visible
      const allBanners = document.querySelectorAll('c-banner-content')
      let foundBanner = null
      allBanners.forEach((banner) => {
        const bannerPageType = banner.getAttribute('data-page-type')
        const bannerCurrentTemplate = banner.getAttribute('data-current-template')

        if (bannerPageType === bannerCurrentTemplate) {
          checkBannerStorage(banner)
        }
      })

      if (allBanners.length > 0 && foundBanner === null) {
        allBanners.forEach((banner) => {
          const bannerPageType = banner.getAttribute('data-page-type')

          if (bannerPageType === 'all') {
            checkBannerStorage(banner)
          }
        })
      }
    })()

  <script>
    /* Le garde évite une SyntaxError « already been declared » quand l'éditeur
       de thème réinjecte la section — la classe reste bornée à ce bloc. */
    if (!customElements.get('slide-push-mobile')) {
      class SlidePushMobile extends HTMLElement {
        constructor() {
          super()
          this.observer = null
        }

        connectedCallback() {
          this.initIntersectionObserver()
        }

        disconnectedCallback() {
          if (this.observer) {
            this.observer.disconnect()
          }
        }

        initIntersectionObserver() {
          const slideContainer = this.querySelector('.slide-push-menu-mobile')
          const slides = this.querySelectorAll('.slide-push-menu-mobile__item')
          const progressBar = this.querySelector('.embla__progress__bar')

          // Slide unique : la barre n'est pas rendue, il n'y a rien à suivre.
          if (slides.length === 0 || !progressBar) return

          const observerOptions = {
            root: slideContainer,
            rootMargin: '0px',
            threshold: 0.6,
          }

          this.observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry) => {
              if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                const slideIndex = Array.from(slides).indexOf(entry.target)

                progressBar.style.transform = `translate3d(${slideIndex * 100}%, 0, 0)`
              }
            })
          }, observerOptions)

          slides.forEach((slide) => {
            this.observer.observe(slide)
          })
        }
      }

      customElements.define('slide-push-mobile', SlidePushMobile)
    }
  </script>

<script>
  ;(() => {
    // Ordre = priorite de detection. `display` = nom commercial affiche dans la
    // mention legale ; jamais traduit (guidelines Apple / Google).
    const WALLETS = [
      { name: 'apple_pay', tag: 'shopify-apple-pay-button', allow: 'allowApplePay', display: 'Apple Pay' },
      { name: 'google_pay', tag: 'shopify-google-pay-button', allow: 'allowGooglePay', display: 'Google Pay' },
      { name: 'paypal', tag: 'shopify-paypal-button', allow: 'allowPaypal', display: 'PayPal' },
    ]

    // Shopify.PaymentButton.init() est amorce par content_for_header sur
    // DOMContentLoaded, puis sonde les capacites du navigateur en asynchrone.
    // Aucune echeance ne peut donc partir du parsing : elle s'ancre sur `load`.
    const GRACE_AFTER_LOAD = 1500
    // Filet si `load` ne vient jamais (sous-ressource tierce bloquee).
    const HARD_CAP = 8000

    // La ligne cadeau du payload express, rendue par `fast-checkout-items`.
    const GIFT_LINE = '[data-express-gift-line]'

    class FastCheckout extends HTMLElement {
      connectedCallback() {
        this.onCartAdd = this.onCartAdd.bind(this)
        document.addEventListener('cart:add-success', this.onCartAdd)

        this.startWalletDetection()
      }

      disconnectedCallback() {
        document.removeEventListener('cart:add-success', this.onCartAdd)
        this.stopWalletDetection()
      }

      /**
       * Retranche la ligne cadeau quand le panier vient de la servir.
       *
       * Le Liquid tranche au rendu, en lisant `cart.items` : un ajout fait
       * ensuite, sans rechargement, laisserait ce formulaire avec des inputs
       * perimes et servirait un second cadeau.
       *
       * Le filet est pose sur l'evenement et non sur la section, parce que
       * `<c-product-form>` resout sa cible de re-rendu depuis l'hote qui
       * soumet : la barre collante est une section a part, tout comme le
       * cross-sell et les cartes Algolia. `cart:add-success` bulle jusqu'au
       * document depuis n'importe laquelle d'entre elles.
       *
       * Zero requete : on lit la reponse de `cart/add.js` que l'ajout a deja
       * ramenee, dont les lignes portent leur `handle` et leurs `properties`.
       *
       * `_child` reste pose sur la ligne parente meme quand la ligne cadeau est
       * retranchee : un second ajout du meme produit fait donc lui aussi
       * conclure « servi », ce qui est la bonne reponse.
       *
       * Sens inverse non couvert : si le produit quitte le panier, la ligne
       * revient au rechargement. Aucun retrait ne part de la page produit.
       */
      onCartAdd(e) {
        const items = e.detail?.data?.items
        if (!Array.isArray(items)) return

        const handle = this.dataset.productHandle
        if (!handle) return

        const served = items.some((item) => item.handle === handle && item.properties?._child)
        if (served) this.querySelector(GIFT_LINE)?.replaceChildren()
      }

      startWalletDetection() {
        if (this.dataset.wallet) return
        this.stopWalletDetection()

        // Dynamic checkout coupe cote boutique -> rien a attendre.
        if (!this.querySelector('.shopify-payment-button')) return this.resolveWallet('none')

        // Le pronostic SERVEUR ne peut jamais reveler ni choisir le libelle (le
        // client sonde encore les capacites), mais il borne les issues possibles :
        // si aucune ne mene a un wallet autorise, il n'y a rien a attendre.
        if (this.hasReachableWallet() === false) return this.resolveWallet('none')

        // Chemin reinjection : portable-wallets a deja peuple le sous-arbre.
        if (this.tryResolveWallet()) return

        this.walletObserver = new MutationObserver(() => this.tryResolveWallet())
        this.walletObserver.observe(this, { childList: true, subtree: true })

        this.hardCapTimer = setTimeout(() => this.finishWalletDetection(), HARD_CAP)

        this.onWindowLoad = () => {
          this.graceTimer = setTimeout(() => this.finishWalletDetection(), GRACE_AFTER_LOAD)
        }
        if (document.readyState === 'complete') this.onWindowLoad()
        else window.addEventListener('load', this.onWindowLoad, { once: true })
      }

      stopWalletDetection() {
        this.walletObserver?.disconnect()
        this.walletObserver = null
        clearTimeout(this.hardCapTimer)
        clearTimeout(this.graceTimer)
        if (this.onWindowLoad) window.removeEventListener('load', this.onWindowLoad)
        this.onWindowLoad = null
      }

      // Les seules issues possibles sont `recommended` et son repli `fallback`,
      // tous deux porteurs d'un JSON `{ name, ... }`. `false` = aucune ne mene a
      // un wallet autorise. `undefined` = forme inattendue, on ne conclut rien.
      hasReachableWallet() {
        const node = this.querySelector('shopify-accelerated-checkout')
        if (!node) return undefined

        const reachable = []
        for (const attr of ['recommended', 'fallback']) {
          const raw = node.getAttribute(attr)
          if (!raw) {
            if (attr === 'recommended') return undefined
            continue
          }
          let parsed
          try {
            parsed = JSON.parse(raw)
          } catch {
            return undefined
          }
          if (!parsed || !parsed.name) return undefined
          reachable.push(parsed.name)
        }
        return WALLETS.some((w) => reachable.includes(w.name) && this.dataset[w.allow] !== 'false')
      }

      tryResolveWallet() {
        const allowed = WALLETS.find((w) => this.dataset[w.allow] !== 'false' && this.querySelector(w.tag))
        if (allowed) {
          this.resolveWallet(allowed.name)
          return true
        }
        // Un wallet de marque non autorise est rendu -> portable-wallets a tranche.
        if (WALLETS.some((w) => this.querySelector(w.tag))) {
          this.resolveWallet('none')
          return true
        }
        return false
      }

      finishWalletDetection() {
        if (this.dataset.wallet) return
        if (!this.tryResolveWallet()) this.resolveWallet('none')
      }

      resolveWallet(name) {
        this.stopWalletDetection()
        this.dataset.wallet = name
        if (name !== 'none') this.applyWalletName(name)
        // Detection terminee -> retire le skeleton dans tous les cas
        this.removeAttribute('data-loading')
      }

      // Ecrit le nom commercial du wallet detecte dans le slot de la mention
      // legale. Le span[data-wallet-name] vient de la chaine traduite
      // (`products.product.fast_checkout.legal_html`), pas du Liquid : s'il
      // manque (traduction cassee), on laisse le defaut rendu cote serveur —
      // la phrase reste grammaticale, seule la marque peut etre fausse.
      // `textContent` : ni HTML, ni regex, idempotent par construction.
      applyWalletName(name) {
        const wallet = WALLETS.find((w) => w.name === name)
        const slot = this.querySelector('[data-wallet-name]')
        if (!wallet || !slot) return
        slot.textContent = wallet.display
      }
    }

    if (!window.customElements.get('c-fast-checkout')) {
      window.customElements.define('c-fast-checkout', FastCheckout)
    }
  })()
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const emailInput = document.getElementById('NewsletterForm--sections--27489870381370__newsletter')
    const messageEror = document.querySelector('.message--error')
    const submitButton = document.getElementById('Subscribe')

    if (emailInput) {
      emailInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        validateEmail()
      })

      emailInput.addEventListener('blur', function () {
        validateEmail()
      })
    }

    function validateEmail() {
      const email = emailInput.value.trim()
      const emailRegex = /^([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+)@([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+)\.([a-zA-Z]{2,5})$/

      // Remove existing error classes
      messageEror.classList.remove('email-invalid')

      if (email && !emailRegex.test(email)) {
        messageEror.classList.add('email-invalid')
        emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true')
      } else {
        emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false')
      }
    }

    // Prevent form submission if email is invalid
    if (submitButton) {
      submitButton.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        const email = emailInput.value.trim()
        const emailRegex = /^([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+)@([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+)\.([a-zA-Z]{2,5})$/

        if (email && !emailRegex.test(email)) {
          e.preventDefault()
          emailInput.focus()
          validateEmail()
        }
      })
    }
  })
</script>

    <script>
      (function () {
        // globalWidgets must NOT stay NEED_TO_LOAD if it fails (error) OR never
        // settles (hang) — base waits on it in GFG_DEPENDENCIES, so it would block
        // ALL discount modules. A once-only settle() flips it to DONT_LOAD and
        // re-fires gfg:module:loaded so the base dependency waiter proceeds. On a
        // successful load the script sets its own status; we only clear the timeout.
        var settled = false;
        var timer;
        function settle(failed) {
          if (settled) return;
          settled = true;
          if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
          if (failed) {
            if (window.gfgFileStatus) { window.gfgFileStatus.globalWidgets = 'DONT_LOAD'; }
            document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('gfg:module:loaded', { detail: { moduleName: 'globalWidgets' } }));
          }
        }
        var s = document.createElement('script');
        s.async = true;
        s.src = "https:\/\/cdn.shopify.com\/extensions\/01a18d93-aa96-7b1c-bc32-2bb691cafc8f\/free-gift-28-825\/assets\/globalWidgets.min.js";
        s.addEventListener('load', function () { settle(false); });
        s.addEventListener('error', function () { settle(true); });
        timer = setTimeout(function () { settle(true); }, 15000);
        document.head.appendChild(s);
      })();
    </script>
